(i) ATRA sensitises HNC cells to radiation and (ii) ATRA‐treated cells have a higher recruitment rate.
(i) radiotherapy alone induces cell recruitment, (ii) ATRA combined with RT has a greater effect on cell recruitment than RT alone and (iii) ATRA alone has no impact on cell recruitment.

In summary, our research is concerned with
the effect of ATRA combined to ionizing radiation (IR) on the recruitment of CSCs in a head and necar carcinoma model.
the impact of targeted therapy on the recruited cancer stem cells and the role of the quiescent cancer stem cells in the repopulation of head and neck cancers.
the impact of ATRAs on the CSC population and their role in treatment resistance.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the combination of ATRA and radiotherapy is a promising therapeutic strategy for HNC, as it is effective in destroying the CSC population, while also reducing the number of quiescent cells.
the combined treatment with ATRA and RT is effective for the eradication of the HNC cell populations.

(1) ATRA combined with RT significantly reduced HNC growth; (2) ATRA combined treatment reduced CSC population in the tumour; (3) ATRA combined RT increased the recruitment of CSCs; and (4) the combination of ATRA with radiotherapy increased the number of cells in the G2 phase.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
ATRA and radiation are synergistic in killing the HNC cell line FaDu.
ATRA combined with radiation has a positive impact on the survival of HNC cells, and the effect of ATRA is more prominent in CSCs.
ATRA and radiation therapy have an additive effect on the destruction of head and neck cancer cells.
The main takeaway from our work is that
ATRA can sensitize CSCs to radiotherapy and can reduce the repopulation effect of CSC recruitment.
ATRA‐treated cells are more sensitive to radiotherapy, but the recruitment of CSCs into the cell cycle is also increased.
ATRA can be used as a radiosensitizer in the treatment of HNC and that ATRA‐mediated recruitment of CSCs into the cell cycle can enhance the effect of treatment on HNC.
